source.title: Freezing revisited: coordinated autonomic and central optimization of threat coping

confidence_rationale: Review and computational framework: freezing on threat detection is an active state for gathering evidence, previsioning responses and preparing fight or flight, coordinated by NA and ACh with the autonomic system -- not a passive fear state. Supports MECH-599's consumer contract (defensive consumers read predicted threat, and freeze has an informational function) and bears on the MECH-279 raw-z_harm_a freeze gating tension. Theoretical.
failure_signatures: Freezing is triggered by threat DETECTION and serves evidence gathering; a freeze gate driven by accumulated injury magnitude and duration has no informational role and is a different state.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Freezing, upon threat detection, allows evidence to be gathered, response possibilities to be previsioned and preparations made for fight or flight; its somatic and cognitive characteristics conceal overt responses while optimizing sensory processing and action preparation, coordinated by noradrenaline and acetylcholine across central and autonomic systems.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports MECH-599's consumer contract: freeze entry is a response to predicted/detected threat with an evidence-gathering function (close to SD-099 orienting), which is different from MECH-279's current gating on raw z_harm_a x duration. The claim notes surface that tension without adjudicating it; this review is literature on the 'threat-read' side. MECH-279's catatonia phenotype may still justify an injury-driven pathological freeze, so this does not settle it.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Theoretical review with a proposed computational framework; not an experiment. It concerns human and animal freezing broadly and does not speak to cue specificity of the threat predictor.
mapping.source_context: Review and computational framework, human and animal freezing, autonomic physiology

confidence_components.notes: Strong authors and venue; mapping is to the consumer contract only.
